usedFor: SafetyCulture holds inspections and actions, LeadConnector holds contacts, and “Inspection Completed” in SafetyCulture can feed “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Any Inspection Completed” in SafetyCulture, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: Any inspection completed, across all templates, creates the contact or updates an existing one.

watchOut: “Inspection Completed” is polling and covers one selected template, while “Any Inspection Completed” is pushed and covers all of them.
